info.title: api.proto
info.description:
The datasource playground: where a person exercises the module.

It plays the host's part. In a deployment the host holds a tenant's
credential and hands one over for a single call; here the playground reads
the tenant store's own credential from the composition and passes it the
same way, so what runs is the real read path and not a stub of it.

post.summary:
Prove writes an object into the tenant store and reads it back through
the bucket datasource, carrying the store's credential per call.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: ProveRequest runs the bucket datasource against the composed tenant store.

get.summary: Version answers which build is serving.

key.description:
key is the object to write and read back. Empty picks a generated one,
so a person can run the proof repeatedly without choosing a name.

content.description: content is what to write. Empty writes a generated line.

bucket.description:
bucket is the tenant store's bucket to read. It is part of a source's
configuration — in a deployment the person who connects the source names
it — and the object-storage agent publishes no bucket name to its
dependents, so the proof is told rather than guessing. Empty uses the
agent's own default for a store with none configured.

apiProveRequest.description: ProveRequest runs the bucket datasource against the composed tenant store.

steps.description: steps are what the proof did.

proven.description: proven is true when every step succeeded.

apiProveResponse.description:
ProveResponse is what happened, step by step, in the order it happened. A
step that failed carries its reason and is the last one.

name.description: name says which step this is.

detail.description: detail is what the step observed, in a person's terms.

failure.description: failure is empty when the step succeeded.

apiProveStep.description: ProveStep is one step of the proof.

version.description: version is the service version codefly stamped into this build.

apiVersionResponse.description: VersionResponse carries the serving build's version.
